title: staleness is order in the author's log, not whether this package was acted on
note: Run from the repository root. Consumer state files start absent; delete *.state.json to rerun.

steps.label: A latest, fresh consumer S1
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P4/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P4/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P4/S1.state.json

steps.label: A after B witnessed, fresh consumer S2
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P4/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P4/log_AB.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P4/S2.state.json
